title: navarretia atractyloides var. hamata
intro: Navarretia atractyloides var. hamata, commonly known as  Devil's Claw or  Yellow Toadshades, is a plant species in the Polemoniaceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Navarretia atractyloides var. hamata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
